title: Video to MP3 Audio Conversion
summary: Convert MP4 to MP3 M4A AAC WAV
description:
Video to MP3 -

Convert videos into high-quality audio files quickly and easily. Extract audio tracks from your own videos and save them in popular formats for listening, editing, or storage.
Select a video from your library, choose an audio format, and convert with a single tap. Designed for speed, simplicity, and on-device processing.

Core Features

Convert video files to audio formats
Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and more
Export audio as MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, or FLAC
Trim audio to keep only the parts you need
Edit file names before saving
Batch conversion for multiple videos
Waveform view for accurate trimming
Preview audio before saving
Save files directly to the Files app
Share via AirDrop, Messages, or email
Conversion history and file management
Offline, on-device processing
Private and secure by design

Supported Audio Formats

MP3
Widely supported format suitable for everyday listening and sharing.

M4A
High audio quality with efficient file size, optimized for modern devices.

AAC
Excellent balance between compression and sound quality.

WAV
Uncompressed audio for professional editing workflows.

FLAC

Lossless compression for preserving original audio quality.
Trim and Edit Audio
Use the waveform editor to select precise start and end points. Easily remove unwanted sections or save specific portions of your audio for personal use.
Batch Conversion
Convert multiple videos at once. Choose a format and let the app process your queue efficiently while tracking progress for each file.

Ideal For -

Students extracting audio from recorded lectures
Creators working with their own video recordings
Professionals saving audio from presentations or meetings
Language learners practicing listening skills
Users managing storage by keeping audio instead of video

Why Choose This App - 
 
Fast and reliable conversion performance
All processing happens on your device
No internet connection required
Simple interface with powerful tools
Designed for both casual and advanced users

Premium Features - 

Unlimited conversions
Access to all audio formats
Batch processing support
Advanced audio settings
Background conversion
Ad-free experience
Privacy & Storage

Your files are processed entirely on your device. Videos are not uploaded or stored externally. 
Converted audio files remain under your control and can be managed, shared, or deleted at any time.
